# Lifecycle models

<!-- Generated by `pnpm e2e:models:docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The riskiest multi-step lifecycles of BandWith, written as XState state machines **for tests only** (the app does not use XState). Each model is derived from the code, the migrations and the Academy; its states say what the user must see, its events what the user does. `@xstate/graph` generates one path per transition (shortest way to its source state, then the transition; prefixes of longer paths dropped), and every path runs as a Playwright test on the demo build (`e2e/specs/xstate-lifecycles.spec.ts`).

## Where things live

- `e2e/models/lifecycle.ts`: the shared core (`defineLifecycle`, path generation, known bugs).
- `e2e/models/<name>.model.ts`: a model (pure: no Playwright), with the code / migration / Academy sources in its header.
- `e2e/models/<name>.steps.ts`: the Playwright check for every state and the steps for every event.
- `e2e/specs/xstate-lifecycles.spec.ts`: runs every generated path; after each event the target state's check runs.
- `e2e/models/coverage.ts` and `e2e/models/mermaid.ts`: the coverage report and these pages.

## Run

```sh
pnpm e2e:models:coverage                      # states, transitions, covered, known bugs, manual
pnpm e2e:models:docs                          # rewrite docs/lifecycles (--check in CI-style use)
pnpm e2e lifecycles --project=phone-portrait  # every path
pnpm e2e lifecycles --project=duo-laptop      # the wide subset (also ipad-landscape)
E2E_KNOWN_BUGS=1 pnpm e2e lifecycles --project=phone-portrait  # only the known-bug paths (they fail)
```

## Profiles

Every path runs on phone-portrait. A model's `wide` paths also run on ipad-landscape and duo-laptop (titles tagged `@laptop`). A path whose gesture only one layout allows runs only there (switching overview cards with an edit sheet open: `@duo-book`).

## Known bugs

A path that fails because the **app** is wrong is listed in the model's `knownBugs` (role, profile, steps, evidence, the expected behaviour and its source) and left out of the run, so the suite stays green; the coverage report and the model's page print it. A path that fails because the **model** is wrong gets the model fixed.

None.
